analysis_definitions.cycle_mean_trend: Normalized OLS slope per episode of the mean reward of the final eight complete 32-episode curriculum cycles.
analysis_definitions.greedy_validation_trends: Normalized OLS slope per episode over the final eight validation checkpoints after averaging the eight fixed validation conditions at each checkpoint.
analysis_definitions.phase_component: Within the final 64 training episodes, rewards are grouped by fixed curriculum phase (episode_index mod 32). The two observations for each phase are averaged, repeated in their original order, and the OLS slope of this reconstructed phase component is normalized by the mean absolute raw reward of the same window.
analysis_definitions.phase_demeaned_residual: Raw reward minus the reconstructed fixed-phase component, with its OLS slope normalized by the same raw-reward scale.
analysis_definitions.right_censoring: Runs reaching 1280 episodes without satisfying the predeclared stopping rule are treated as right-censored at 1280, not as convergence at 1280.
analysis_definitions.survival_summary: Kaplan-Meier median time to stopping criterion and restricted mean time to criterion through the predeclared administrative limit of 1280 episodes. No hypothesis test is performed.
